map.string: Warm single-source portrait; deep short-side shadow, cheek triangle.
Glamour front-key high above lens axis, under-nose shadow; soft under-fill.
Flattering 2:1 news/doc coverage with a background wash.
Hard white side-key, no fill, blade-edge shadows.
Subject as a black cutout against blasted backlight and cold sky wash.
Low warm sun from behind, amber bounce fill, cool sky counter-wash.
Cold top-heavy moonlight with one warm practical accent.
Duotone club split — pink and cyan hard cross, purple hair snoot.
Low warm flicker source below the eyeline, cool night rim. Pair with the Fire Flicker FX.
Portrait workhorse; small nose-loop shadow, one notch fuller than Rembrandt.
Hard side key at 90°, level; face divided light/dark, drama.
Front key high + front under-fill; glamour, near-even, catchlight top&bottom.
Bright, near-shadowless, key≈fill, background lit; fashion / comedy.
Single hard warm source, deep shadow, no fill, cool whisper rim.
Cold source below the eyeline; ominous, unnatural.
Hard overhead; eye-socket shadow, interrogation / menace.
Soft directional daylight one high side, cool ambient fill + wash.
Very soft even wrap, low contrast, neutral-cool, near-shadowless.
Warm key, cool cyan fill + rim; the blockbuster grade.
Cold hard key, cyan rims; clinical / tech.
Warm candle/incandescent wash — the whole shot at 2700K.
Studio tungsten warmth — even 3200K key, fill and rim.
Hard white key through venetian blinds; no fill, snoot hair-light.
Soft daylight through window panes, one high side; cool ambient fill and wash.
Cold hard key striped by bars; white rim, no fill.
Warm sun pooled through leaves, green bounce, branch-broken cool rim.
Neutral overhead through a paned skylight; soft under-fill.
Cold hard light rises beneath the face; a restrained blood rim separates the silhouette.
Warm close soft sources wrap the face with a delicate golden hair light.
A dark centre is carved by opposing cyan and deep-blue edges with a cool background wash.
Magenta and cyan cross-light the face while purple and red accents punch through the background.
Key from beyond the far cheek; the camera side falls into shadow — the slimming, editorial complement to Loop and Rembrandt.
One hard warm shaft from high side, five-stop chiaroscuro plunge, background swallowed by black — Baroque tenebrism.
Fluorescent green-tinged top light, cold floor bounce, steel-blue edge — autopsy rooms, cold opens, bad news.
Overhead sodium streetlamp pools amber over the subject; the night beyond is dead blue — the Fincher parking-lot look. Pairs with the Streetlight FX.
Blown white halo from behind, near-shadowless cool wrap in front — dream sequences, afterlife, memory. Distinct from High Key: the exposure lives in the backlight.
A single tight follow-spot from the house, faint Congo-blue stage behind — stand-up, torch song, curtain call.
Boxing-ring geometry: hard overhead array, canvas bounce from below, twin hard white kickers carving both shoulders — sweat-and-glory sports drama.
Close frontal ring: on-axis soft key plus lower-ring fill, LED wall behind — the creator-studio look. Enable the rig catchlight for the signature eye ring.
A warm sunbeam through leaded panes cuts the stone gloom from high; Congo-blue darkness everywhere else — confessions, weddings, vigils.
Monochrome irradiated amber from every direction, deliberately low contrast — the Blade Runner 2049 Vegas wasteland.
Cyan surface light dappled by caustics from above, Congo-blue depth fill, cold void behind. Pair with the Underwater FX for motion.
Brutal near-vertical sun, hot sand bounce from below, background baked bright — western stand-offs and desert exteriors.
Grid-diffused ceiling tubes with the Plus Green sickness, a window's daylight spilling from the side — cubicle realism. Pairs with the Elevator Fault FX.
Cold street light through window panes, blue night ambience, a neon sign's pink bleeding in from outside — insomnia, stake-outs, city apartments at 3 a.m.

1979 soundstage disco: a hard cool spot from straight overhead, green and blue laser blades low around the performer, black void beyond. Companion to the Rock With You FX (48) — this static setup holds the look between takes; enable per-light Shafts on Key/Rim/Bg and Shadow policy 'all projectors' so the beams read through haze.
Top-key drops the eyes into shadow; warm amber gloom — the offer you can't refuse.
A table of candles just below the face; soft warm wrap, period gloom beyond.
Red key, blue fill, green edge, magenta wall — the ballet school as a nightmare.
Ink-hard B&W — one hot white slash, one blown edge, nothing else survives.
Sterile shadowless white; a single red eye watching from behind.
Warm tungsten noir brushed with green fluorescence — Hong Kong corridors at midnight.
Failing fluorescent grid overhead, sodium amber seeping in — the city that gave up.
Slatted light through smoke, pink neon bleed, deep blue city night — Deckard's apartment.
EL cyan glow out of blackness, one hostile orange edge — you're on the Grid.
A low fire rakes the face out of total darkness; the horror stays unlit.
Everything drowned in red; a whisper of magenta is the only way out.
The green cast that tells you none of this is real.
One hard raking key; the shadow on the wall is the monster.
Golden faces in a green world — Montmartre as a picture book.
Golden water ripples crawl over the subject; everything else is amber darkness.
